Optimization of a molecular scaffold to maximize a scoring function, starting from a benzimidazole core structure.

**Initial Exploration (Iterations 1-5):**
The optimization began with unsubstituted benzimidazole (score: 0.440) and systematically explored substitutions at the 2-position. Sequential improvements were achieved through methyl (0.470), phenyl (0.492), para-chlorophenyl (0.500), and para-trifluoromethylphenyl (0.521) substitutions.

A significant improvement occurred when methoxy groups were introduced on the benzimidazole ring. Adding a single methoxy at the 5-position dramatically increased the score to 0.642. Larger amines (propylamino, morpholine, pyrrolidine) decreased scores.
